title: Sloped Drip-Groove Window Sill
description: One original static architectural window-sill module: one continuous thick stone-profile solid combines a complete outward-sloping upper bed, a full-width higher rear upstand, a short flat front nose, and a real full-width open-bottom drip groove through both lateral end profiles. The rear upstand and sloped bed make an open upper rebate; the underside groove is genuinely recessed empty geometry, not a painted line. One editable closed mesh and two constant opaque untextured PBR materials bound to existing faces. Native metres, Z up, front -Y. Exactly one architectural module and zero scenes, no window/wall/host, scene, human, water, fixing, hidden support, old model geometry, textures or variants. The lowest two finite underside strips establish Z=0 geometric datum only. The module needs a separately designed external host; the source does not certify mounting, standalone stability, water shedding, waterproofing, building-code compliance, drainage performance, structural load, manufacture, installation or compatibility with an existing window opening.
